Add a question, choose Likert, and pick the agreement scale it answers on.

![The likert question question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/likert-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/likert-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Answer set.** The labelled scale, such as Strongly disagree to Strongly agree. Items of 1 scale share it.
- **Scale.** The scale the item scores into, so its score and reliability are computed together.
- **Reverse-scored.** For an item worded against the others, so a high answer means the same on every item.

## Best practices for research

Label every point, not only the ends, and keep 1 idea per item: an item that asks 2 things cannot be answered for either.

Reference: Krosnick, J. A., & Presser, S. (2010). Question and questionnaire design. In P. V. Marsden & J. D. Wright (Eds.), *Handbook of survey research* (2nd ed., pp. 263-313). Emerald.
